description: An ever-evolving, interactive generative-art site. Tune a live gravity-well starfield, shape your own galaxy, and share the exact result as a single URL. No account or backend required.

capabilities.name: generate-galaxy
capabilities.description: Compose an interactive gravity-well starfield that reacts to cursor and controls.

capabilities.name: tune-galaxy
capabilities.description: Adjust spiral arms, rotation speed, star density, colour theme, gravity well, zoom, and layered effects (nebula, comet trail, shooting stars, stellar depth, constellation mode).

capabilities.name: share-galaxy
capabilities.description: Encode any galaxy state as a shareable URL; a shared link re-hydrates the exact galaxy on open.

capabilities.name: galaxy-of-the-day
capabilities.description: A fresh, seeded galaxy with a creative prompt, refreshed once per calendar day.

recipe_format.description: A galaxy is fully described by URL query parameters; any combination re-hydrates a specific galaxy.

parameters.<layer>: effect layer toggles, e.g. nebula=on, comet=on, shootingstars=on, stardepth=on, constellation=on
